mission: Build the data and deployment infrastructure for physical AI. Precise, honest footage of real work, collected fast and at scale.

values.s: Fix it on the floor, now. Don't wait for a layer above you.
Radical honesty. No shortcuts, no fake footage, no lazy camera work.
Feedback is fuel. Anyone, at any level, says what they see.
Performance and initiative open doors here without a ceiling.
Treat every phone, mount, and cap as if you paid for it.
Full responsibility for your domain, and help for your teammates.
Focus and discipline in every task. Every 30-minute window shapes the dataset.
